svg.title: OmniRoboAgent architecture
svg.desc: Current modular embodied agent framework, with explicit execution, context, recovery and evolution lanes. Purple dashed development lane denotes unfinished trainable HV work.

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: OmniRoboAgent 通才智能体框架全景

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: 任务图驱动的闭环执行、多尺度记忆与证据约束的自进化

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: 任务与配置

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: Task / RunConfig / AgentConfig

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: Runtime · 回合生命周期与调度

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: SyncRuntime：步数、时限、动作预算、终止原因与资源释放

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif

显式执行状态与预算归 Pipeline 所有；不推断视觉语义

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: Memory · 多尺度上下文

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: TieredMemory：工作帧、事件、摘要
ReflectiveMemory：重复失败经验
SpatialMemory：空间布局与对象
CompositeMemory：组合各分区

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: 64 项契约；能力、前后置条件
显式 route / binding / verifier
Task Graph 节点绑定 atomic ID
宏技能映射与模型动作分开
目录不等于全部后端已验证

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Arial Unicode MS, sans-serif
text.tspan: 蓝：执行与观测 绿：显式上下文 橙：recovery 紫：经验演化 虚线：反馈或开发进展；箭头表示逻辑流，不表示 Python import
